title: Simple English: one deck, two ways to read it
subtitle: A deck whose slides switch to plainer words with one button

sections.title: One button swaps a slide to plainer words
sections.label: In short
sections.text: Each slide can hold a second version of its text. The Simple English button in the bar shows it, and the deck keeps your choice.
points: The deck opens in normal text.
Slide count, order and links stay the same.

simple.title: One button gives a slide plainer words
simple.text: A slide can hold a plainer version of its text. Press Simple English in the bar to read it. The deck keeps your choice.
points: The deck starts in normal text.
The slides stay in the same order.
Code and numbers stay the same.

items.title: Tab to the bar
items.text: The Simple English button sits next to the theme button.

items.title: Press Enter or Space
items.text: The current slide changes at once, and the deck stays on it.
The Simple English button is next to the theme button.
The slide changes at once. You stay on the same slide.

sections.title: The two views differ only in wording
sections.label: Two views

columns.title: Simple English
points: Opens when you ask for it.
You press the button to see it.

sections.title: Slides keep their length
sections.text: The plain version has the same shape as the normal one. A slide never splits in two because of it.

simple.text: Both versions have the same shape. No slide splits in two.
